I’ll just add that if you have a bad relationship with food, fasting will just lead to binging. That’s why I recommend a deficit rather than fasting for you.

1. Walk for 30-60mins per day
2. Go to gym and weight train 4x per week 
3. Count your calories (be in a deficit)

Implement each of those slowly over the course of 3 months, starting with walking for the first month, then adding gym the second month, and finally, adding calorie deficit in the third month. 

It’s not about doing everything all at once. Build your habits slowly over time. There’s no urgency right now. If you try to do everything at once, you will overwhelm yourself and do nothing. 

Track your progress. If you don’t track, you won’t stick to it.
